Name: DE-UserTypologiesHistory
Description: Extracts the historical data of the typologies where the user has been inside the company.
Statement:
select  uth.Oid as UserTypologyHistoryId,
        uth.StartDate,
        uth.EndDate,
        cre.Id as CreatedById,
        cre.Name as CreatedBy,
        cre.HasImage as CreatedByHasImage,
        mod.Id as ModifiedById,
        mod.Name as ModifiedBy,
        mod.HasImage as ModifiedByHasImage,
        usr.Id as UserId,
        usr.Name as [User],
        usr.HasImage as UserHasImage,
        typ.Oid as TypologyId,
        typ.Name as Typology,
        tgp.Oid as TypologyGroupId,
        tgp.Name as TypologyGroup,
        ust.Oid as UserTypeId,
        ust.Name as UserType,
        dep.Id as DepartmentId,
        dep.Name as Department
from    UserTypologyHistory uth
            join UserLookup usr on usr.Id = uth.[User]
            join UserTypology typ on typ.Oid = uth.Typology
            left join UserTypologyGroup tgp on tgp.Oid = uth.TypologyGroup
            join DepartmentLookup dep on dep.Id = uth.Department
            left join UserType ust on ust.Oid = uth.UserType
            join UserLookup cre on cre.Id = uth.CreatedBy
            join UserLookup mod on mod.Id = uth.ModifiedBy
